detail.title: Predictive Dissipation and Thermodynamic Information Engines
detail.summary: This journal entry updates the synthesis of predictive information processing and thermodynamic dissipation, incorporating new evidence on entropy production bounds and non-reciprocal couplings in information engines.

detail.title: Predictive Dissipation and Information Engines (Revised)
detail.summary: This revision synthesizes findings on entropy production bounds and the role of non-reciprocal couplings in autonomous information engines, establishing that predictive information and passive degrees of freedom provide concrete upper bounds on dissipation in driven systems.
detail.reason: Incorporating recent peer-reviewed bounds on entropy production and non-reciprocal coupling dynamics to refine the project's understanding of dissipation.
